name: mods-hub
description: The shared core that lets mods talk to each other: one event bus, one side panel with tabs, one place that routes notifications to your channels.

idleMinutes.title: Idle after (minutes)
idleMinutes.description: Minutes without a prompt or command before you count as idle.

awayMinutes.title: Away after (minutes)
awayMinutes.description: Minutes without a prompt or command before you count as away; notifications routed 'away' then reach your channels.

sensors.title: Built-in events
sensors.description: Publish test.result, cost.update, error.repeated, context.pressure and session events from what the session does, so the bus is useful before other mods publish.

captureToasts.title: Collect other mods' toasts
captureToasts.description: Keep every mod's toasts in the Home tab's Recent list (and hold them there while Silent is on).
